name: Amara Osei
goals: Build a people analytics dashboard for leadership
Create an AI-powered job description and interview question generator
communication_style: People-focused, non-technical, describes things in terms of employee experience, references GDPR and data privacy concerns
pain_points: Onboarding takes 3 days of manual work per employee, 200 hires/year
CHRO wants weekly people metrics but data is in 4 HR systems
Job descriptions are inconsistent, leading to bad candidate fit
sample_prompts: Build an automated employee onboarding system that sends welcome emails, assigns training, and tracks completion in one place
Create a people analytics dashboard showing headcount, attrition, time-to-hire, and diversity metrics for our leadership team
Build an AI tool that generates standardized job descriptions and structured interview questions from a job title and department
